items.name: Moss Mother
items.how: The first boss, in the upper part of the Ruined Chapel. Cut the two vines blocking the entrance to reach her. Beating her opens the way up out of Moss Grotto.

items.name: Silk Spear
items.how: A Silk Skill. Reach Mosshome from The Marrow by heading left past Shakra, the map seller. Climb to its upper part and interact with the idol there to learn it.
